author: KEXP
description: Pioneer in the Korean music scene and Gyeonggi folk singer Lee Heemoon leads #OBSG in a bold, synth-heavy performance in our latest in-studio session. With host Diana Ratsamee, the band share a performance of "DOHWA" and more.
title: OBSG performs "DOHWA" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents OBSG performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded February 16, 2026.

Songs:  
DOHWA 00:33
NEUNSIL 03:57
YOGOSI 07:01
EULSSASSA 10:17
EUHEUGUJA 14:35

Heemoon Lee - Main Vocal, Frontman
Seon Teck Noh - Bass guitar, Band Master
Ranhee Seon - Elec guitar
Hyunjoon Pak - Keyboards
Hyunggyun Kim - Drums
Wonseok Jo - Sub Vocals

Host: Diana Ratsamee
Audio Engineer: Julian Martlew
Mastering Engineer: Matt Ogaz

Cameras: Jim Beckmann, Carlos Cruz, Brady Harvey, Jonathan Jacobson & Luke Knecht
